data.input: Read package.json, tell me the exact version ranges of jsonwebtoken and password-validator as written in the file, then change jsonwebtoken to ^9.0.3 with an edit.

update.title: bash: grep -n 'version\|jsonwebtoken\|password-validator' package.json; echo '---'; sed -n 's/.*"\^\([0-9.]*\)".*/\1/p' package.json

tool_call.title: bash: grep -n 'version\|jsonwebtoken\|password-validator' package.json; echo '---'; sed -n 's/.*"\^\([0-9.]*\)".*/\1/p' package.json
